correctness.rationale: For v tensor phi, original torsion on (e,f),(e,h),(f,h) is (c,-b,a) times (4uw+z^2)v; nonzero v makes the conic condition necessary and sufficient. N²=phi(v)N; two commuting rank-one square-zero maps must annihilate. The dual span is at most two-dimensional and a secant of a smooth conic meets exactly two conic points, making the rank polynomial complete. Irreducible incidence families, generic-uniqueness and pairwise noncontainment prove all geometric components. Independent checker exhaustively evaluates original torsion and compositions for four fields.

value.rationale: The exact distribution of simultaneous square-zero Lie Nijenhuis structures is a natural moduli and deformation invariant. A complete arbitrary-length count over all odd finite fields and exponentially many non-equidimensional geometric components distinguish the constrained compatibility geometry from both single-operator results and the unrestricted irreducible commuting-nilpotent matrix variety; this supplies genuine structural information rather than a routine known-table recomputation.
